# aether.nvim

Version: 1.0.0

## Development

1. Add your application source files.
2. Add a CMakeLists.txt that builds and installs your application.
3. Update the description and dependencies in forge.pkg.
4. Create a source archive and set its release URL and real SHA-256 checksum.
5. Test the package before publishing it.

The generated manifest is a starter. The source URL and checksum are
intentionally empty until you publish the actual source archive.
